name: Stadionkneipe
kurzbeschreibung: **Pub with stadium vibes in Füssen** – where football fans and locals meet for hearty Bavarian dishes, cold Weißbier, and the latest match buzz. Right by the Stadion, this cozy spot serves up Obatzda, pretzels, and schnitzel while cheering on the SV Füssen. Perfect for game days or a casual bite with a view of the Forgggenberg!
